# Measurement and Observation Checklist: form shape facts

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the measurement, privacy and observation requirements of this feature — what the shape block measures, what the store may hold, how a failed action is attributed, and how the commit mode is observed — before the owner approves the vocabulary and the two open decisions.
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · **Plan**: [plan.md](../plan.md) · **Tasks**: [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Measurement definitions

- [ ] CHK001 Is "visually hidden" defined exactly — which conditions make a field hidden (`opacity: 0`, `visibility: hidden`, `display: none`, zero size, off-screen)? The requirement says "whether any field is visually hidden" and the only evidence is an `opacity: 0` checkbox. [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §Evidence E1]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the mapping from a page control to the reviewed field types specified — which HTML input types become `date`, `number`, `other`, and what a `textarea`, a multiple `select` or a custom widget becomes? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, Contract `fieldTypes`]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the `main` landmark defined by detection rule — a `<main>` element, `role="main"`, or an ARIA landmark — so two implementations cannot disagree? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §C3]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the rule for a page with more than one form inside `main` specified? The requirement names "the page's only measured form" but not which one is measured. [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a form nested inside another form, or inside a shadow root, addressed? The edge cases cover a same-origin frame but not a nested form. [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "required" defined by detection rule — the `required` attribute, `aria-required`, or a control the page validates — so the count is not implementation-dependent? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]

## Identity and path rules

- [ ] CHK007 Is the root path addressed? `matchPath` returns null for `/` because it has no segment to verify, so a form on a site's home page would get no shape fact at all; the requirement does not say so. [Gap, Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Plan FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the change to the fact-identity pattern specified in the contract? The current pattern admits `ui.control:[a-z]+:.+` only, and the new identity `ui.form.shape:<path>` needs a path with `/`, `-` and digits. [Gap, Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan T003]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the new kind added to the reviewed kinds map in the allowlist, and is the version bump from 2 to 3 the only gate that admits it? [Completeness, Plan T002, T008]
- [ ] CHK010 Is it specified that the stored path is the allowlisted path and never the raw path with a query or a fragment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]

## The gate split and privacy (C6)

- [ ] CHK011 Is the exemption of the counter from the anonymity gate recorded where the owner approves it — the rationale (it holds no page content and mirrors the visit counter that 003 already stores on the very same sites)? [Dependency, Spec §C6, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the scope gate's credential-vault protection stated for the counter as well — a profile under the vault stores nothing — and not only for the shape fact? [Gap, Security, Spec §FR-004, Plan FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the overlap with 003's `ui.login` fact addressed? A form that holds a password field is a sign-in form, so the shape may repeat what `ui.login` already states on the same path. [Consistency, Privacy, Spec §FR-001, §US3]
- [ ] CHK014 Which cap governs the occurrence count? The draft contract caps it at 1,000,000 while the requirement states no cap at all. [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Contract `bounds`]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the downgrade consequence stated and accepted: an older daemon rejects the unknown profile key and quarantines the **whole record** for that origin, not only the counter, so every fact of that site is lost until it is read again. [Risk, Spec §FR-007, Plan FR-007]

## Attribution and observation (C7, C8)

- [ ] CHK016 Is the attribution window given a number? The requirement says "the attribution window" and the plan points at the site map's 120 seconds; the spec fixes no length. [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Plan FR-003]
- [ ] CHK017 Is it specified that the origin comes from the last **observed** read and not from the failed action itself, so a failure after a cross-origin move is attributed to the origin the agent was last reading? [Clarity, Spec §C7, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the observation window stated? The extension reports a navigation only inside its settle window, so a slower navigation is not seen and the mode stays `unknown`; the requirement says only "the address changed". [Gap, Spec §FR-011, §C8]
- [ ] CHK019 Is "the last snapshot" defined for the `button` role — a complete read, a scoped one, a truncated one — and is it stated that a missing ref leaves the mode `unknown`? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the lifetime of the pending commit mode specified — held in memory, lost on a daemon restart, never persisted? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it stated what happens to a pending mode when the next read of that path is scoped, truncated, failed or excluded: dropped, held, or applied? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it specified that the address the daemon reads to decide the mode is never stored, logged or exported — only the boolean decision is kept? [Security, Spec §FR-011, §C8]
- [ ] CHK023 Is it specified that the in-memory `ref → role` map stays in memory, is never persisted and goes with the profile? [Privacy, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Files]
- [ ] CHK024 Is it stated that a mode observed by one profile becomes visible to the other profiles through the shared shape fact, and that this is intended? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §C2]

## Agent-facing output

- [ ] CHK025 Is the drop order specified when the reminder reaches its bound of 8 lines and 600 characters with the two new lines added — which lines are kept and which are cut? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the wording specified for both failure codes? The fixed words say "some controls on this site are not visible", but `ELEMENT_COVERED` means the control is visible and covered by another. [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Contract `fixedWords`]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it specified which `browser_memory` filter shows the counter — it is a profile counter like a visit, not a fact, and the tool offers `all`, `facts` and `visits`. [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the exported shape of the new facts documented? The scenario asks the export to contain them "in the documented shape", and no document defines it. [Gap, Spec §US4, Plan FR-010]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the agent-facing wording reconciled with 003's rule that hints are not instructions? The fixed words tell the agent to "act on them with browser_evaluate", which reads as an instruction. [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §C1]

## Acceptance criteria quality

- [ ] CHK030 Is "in 100% of runs" given a number of runs, so the criterion is measurable rather than rhetorical? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the check for "whose address changed" defined against a signal the test can see, rather than against the page's behaviour? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the Option 2 branch of SC-003 given its own privacy assertion — the one that separates "no name, value or path outside the reviewed list" from the Option 1 branch? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK033 Is it stated that one `delete <origin>` removes the counters of every profile for that origin, not only the acting profile's? [Completeness, Spec §SC-004, §US4]

## Dependencies, assumptions and gates

- [ ] CHK034 Is the approval gate recorded in the same place as the tasks' gate — the vocabulary becomes 003's allowlist version 3 before any stored data changes? [Dependency, Tasks §Gate, Plan §Review]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the exact requirement line each open decision changes recorded, so a reviewer can act on OD-1 and OD-2 without re-reading the whole specification? [Dependency, Spec §OD-1, §OD-2]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the probe's budget behaviour specified — the anonymity probe and the shape probe share one budget, and an overrun answers `anonymous: null`, which also stops the shape? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK037 Does the plan keep every module under the repository's 600-line limit, given that two large modules grow and one new module is added? [NFR, Plan §Files, AGENTS.md]
- [ ] CHK038 Is "no tool changes its behaviour" checkable — is there a test that the tools' results are unchanged apart from the two added lines? [Completeness, Spec §C1, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the owner's part stated — reloading the extension in the profile, and the live measurement of the success criteria on real Chrome — as an owner action with a date? [Dependency, Spec §OD-2, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 Do the failing tests written first cover the new rules — a refusal on a tab that was read, a refusal on a tab that was not, and a commit candidate that moves the address and one that does not? [Completeness, Tasks §T001, §T007, §T008]
